text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I thought someone called out to me— 
Could it actually be you guys?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, isn't there a legend that the 
passionate feelings of Umamusume dwell 
within the Three Goddesses statue...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to beings overflowing with 
romance like you guys, it's only natural 
to be drawn in, haha!
